Care guide - Ridgeline 2P Tent. Pitch and air-dry the fly and body fully before storage to prevent mildew. Do not machine wash; sponge spot-clean with mild soap. Re-seal the seams once a season and store the tent loosely in a cool, dry place to protect the coating.
